adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog` the TRPC `onError` builds a toast message as ```${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}```. `err.message` originates from the server (e.g. TRPCError `message` strings in `addGuests.handler.ts` like `"booking_not_found"`, `"you_do_not_have_permission"`, etc.), so backend-controlled strings are being fed directly into the client translation lookup and then shown to the user. This is diff-grounded and can lead to inconsistent UX/translation-key leakage (and makes the client depend on server message keys), though it’s not necessarily a functional break.
